SELECT p.id, p.name, p.main_image, p.category_id, CASE WHEN pc.id IS NULL THEN c.name ELSE CONCAT(pc.name, ' / ', c.name) END AS category_name, p.sales, p.update_time, MIN(i.price) AS min_price, COALESCE(SUM(i.stock), 0) AS total_stock, COUNT(i.id) AS sku_count FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.visible = 1 LEFT JOIN category pc ON pc.id = c.parent_id AND pc.deleted = 0 JOIN item i ON i.product_id = p.id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.descn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND p.category_id IN
#{cid}
AND 1 = 0
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item s WHERE s.product_id = p.id AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.stock > 0)
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.main_image, p.category_id, c.name, pc.id, pc.name, p.sales, p.update_time, p.create_time ORDER BY
min_price ASC, p.id DESC min_price DESC, p.id DESC p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC p.update_time DESC, p.id DESC
